branches.conclusion: The complete official 2026–27 Business Administration PhD concentration list has Accounting, Finance, Human Resource Management, Information Systems and Marketing, without Operations or Management Science. A 2016 official curriculum bulletin records that former Operations Management PhD concentration was renamed Supply Chain Management effective fall 2015; that historical title is not a current route.

The complete current university program/hierarchy inventory shows Industrial and Systems Engineering as a B.S. major, not a PhD. Current engineering doctorates list Aerospace, Aviation Science and Mechatronics, with no exact eligible title or named specialization in the catalog inventory. Applied/Pure Mathematics and Computer Science PhDs sit outside named qualifying units and no formal eligible specialization is listed in the central inventory.
